title: Allocate one peripheral interrupt source (Source_Y) to CPUx

c.v: Setting the corresponding configuration register INTERRUPT_CORE
to Num_P allocates this interrupt source to Interrupt_P.
Num_P here can be any value from 0 ~ 5, 8 ~ 10, 12 ~ 14, 17 ~ 28, and 30 ~ 31.
interrupt can be shared by multiple peripherals.
